Sophie (PM): Quick sync — we need to decide hardware buckets for onboarding the new 70B-family models. Two asks: (1) pass/fail perf benchmarks per bucket, (2) allowed quantization/latency SLOs. Who can own thresholds?

Ryan C. (Eng-ML): I can take thresholds for latency/cost. Data point: on A100 single-socket we see ~120ms/token median for fp16 at seq_len 512. With q4f16 it drops to ~80ms/token. Need a clear definition of measurement (warm vs cold).

Alex G. (Eng Runtime): Important to define warm-cache vs cold-cache. For catalog ingress we should require warm-cache perf for bucket1, warm+KV cache for bucket2. Also a memory headroom signal: require >20% free GPU memory at steady state.

Maya P. (Prod Ops): From rollout POV customers care about tail latency. Recommend gates on P50/P95/P99. Also suggest restricting aggressive quant (q4*) to non-latency-critical buckets.

Sophie (PM): Proposed minimal gating (draft):
- bucket1 (latency-sensitive): P95 < 200ms, quantization allowed: none or q8_0 only after verification
- bucket2 (balanced): P95 < 500ms, q4f16 allowed with quality checks
- bucket3 (throughput/cost-optimized): no strict P95 gate; target cost-per-token under $0.0003

Ryan C. (Eng-ML): +1 but need a perf harness and standardized eval workloads. I'll add a harness and baseline runs. Example perf config I plan to use:
```
# perf config
seq_len: 512
batch_sizes: [1,4,8]
quant: ["fp16","q4f16"]
metrics: ["p50","p95","p99","tokens/sec"]
```

Nikhil S. (CS): Heads-up — two customers have asked explicitly for bucket1 for compliance workloads; will flag if we need pinning or dedicated capacity. Also please include fallback model variants in the spec.

Maya P. (Prod Ops): Question — should P95 < 200ms be region-agnostic? APAC infra can have higher tail. Recommend region multipliers.

Alex G. (Eng Runtime): Agreed. Propose a region multiplier field in the spec (default 1.0, APAC 1.2). Also define measurement window (5m steady-state, 95th percentile across 24h sample).

Sophie (PM): Action items: Ryan -> perf harness + baseline numbers by EOD Wed; Alex -> draft cache/headroom rules and region multipliers; Maya -> capture rollout gates, comms and SLA phrasing; Nikhil -> surface customer priority list and pin requests. @Ryan C. (Eng-ML) @Alex G. (Eng Runtime) @Maya P. (Prod Ops) @Nikhil S. (CS)

deploy-bot: checklist created: /ops/catalog-onboarding/hardware-buckets/spec-1976543210

qa-bot: task added: "Regression suite for bucket1 latency" — due in 7 days

Maya P. (Prod Ops): small ask — include the eval prompts used by customers in each vertical so we can monitor quality regressions after quant changes.

Ryan C. (Eng-ML): Will include 3 per-vertical prompts + automated metrics (simple embedding-similarity, token-overlap) + human spot checks for quality-sensitive buckets.

Sophie (PM): Locking this as decision draft — we'll review in Friday sync. Thanks everyone :tada:
